name: ordax-studio
description: Connect MCP clients to ORDAX Studio for authenticated project and Blender workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your ORDAX Studio workstation through the generic ORDAX MCP.
interface.longDescription: Use the authenticated ORDAX Studio MCP to inspect and update registered projects and work with Blender through typed, audited actions. The ORDAX MCP is client-neutral; this package is only the ChatGPT distribution adapter.
